<img src="assets/readme/h-about.svg" alt="02 — About me" width="100%" />

I build **systems that make other things easier to make**: a hex terrain generator so level design
stops being manual, a lip-sync add-on so animation stops being frame-by-frame, an agent layer so a
game can start from a sentence.

I'm a final-year Electronics & Communication student at **NIT Jaipur**, building the ARTHIS universe:
a feed of multiplayer mini-games (**ARTHIS.space**) and a handcrafted Unity vertical city
(**ARTHIS.land — The Wall**), powered by a real-time relay I wrote from scratch in pure-stdlib Python.

> **Right now**<br />
> &nbsp;→ &nbsp;Building multiplayer mini-games on **ARTHIS.space**<br />
> &nbsp;→ &nbsp;Crafting **The Wall**, a Unity vertical city<br />
> &nbsp;→ &nbsp;Shipped **RAG + FastAPI** inference at Clymora · built **GPT-2 from scratch**<br />
> &nbsp;→ &nbsp;28 custom **Blender add-ons**: lip-sync, camera rigs, IK posing, render automation
